fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 6))

# Buat matrix missing per platform
missing_matrix = df.groupby('platform')[numeric_cols].apply(
    lambda x: (x.isnull().sum() / len(x) * 100).round(1)
)

sns.heatmap(
    missing_matrix,
    fmt='.0f',
    annot=True,
    cmap='RdYlGn_r',
    linewidths=0.5,
    ax=ax,
    cbar_kws={'label': 'Missing (%)'}
)

ax.set_title('Heatmap Missing Values per Platform (%)\n(Merah = Banyak NaN, Hijau = Tidak Ada NaN)', 
             fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax.set_xlabel('Kolom', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Platform', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=30, ha='right')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('plots/heatmap_missing_values.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 5, figsize=(20, 8))
axes = axes.flatten()

colors = ['steelblue', 'seagreen', 'tomato', 'mediumpurple', 
          'darkorange', 'crimson', 'teal', 'goldenrod', 'slategray', 'deeppink']

    axes[i].hist(data, bins=25, color=colors[i], edgecolor='white', alpha=0.8)
    axes[i].axvline(data.mean(), color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5)
    axes[i].set_title(f'{col}\n(mean={data.mean():.2f}, n={len(data)})', fontsize=10)
    axes[i].set_xlabel('Score')
    axes[i].set_ylabel('Frekuensi')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('plots/distribusi_semua_kolom.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))

platforms = df['platform'].value_counts()
colors_bar = ['#2196F3', '#4CAF50', '#FF5722', '#9C27B0', '#FF9800']

bars = ax.bar(platforms.index, platforms.values, color=colors_bar, 
              edgecolor='white', linewidth=1.5)

for bar, val in zip(bars, platforms.values):
    pct = val / len(df) * 100
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 20,
            f'{val:,}\n({pct:.1f}%)', ha='center', va='bottom', 
            fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

ax.set_title('Jumlah Data Per Platform', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Platform')
ax.set_ylabel('Jumlah Respondent')
ax.set_ylim(0, platforms.max() * 1.2)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('plots/jumlah_per_platform.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

In [14]:
# Kolom yang ada di semua platform (tidak ada NaN structural)
common_cols = ['overall_score', 'cleanliness', 'location', 'service']

platforms_list = df['platform'].unique()
colors_radar = ['#2196F3', '#4CAF50', '#FF5722', '#9C27B0', '#FF9800']

fig = go.Figure()

for i, platform in enumerate(platforms_list):
    platform_data = df[df['platform'] == platform][common_cols].mean().values.tolist()
    platform_data.append(platform_data[0])  # tutup polygon
    
    cols_radar = common_cols + [common_cols[0]]
    
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatterpolar(
        r=platform_data,
        theta=cols_radar,
        fill='toself',
        name=platform,
        opacity=0.6
    ))

fig.update_layout(
    polar=dict(radialaxis=dict(visible=True, range=[8, 10])),
    title='Radar Chart: Profil Rating Per Platform<br>(Kolom yang ada di semua platform)',
    showlegend=True,
    height=500
)
fig.show()
fig.write_html('plots/radar_chart_platform.html')

corr_to_overall = df[numeric_cols].corr()['overall_score'].drop('overall_score').sort_values(ascending=True)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

colors_corr = ['#4CAF50' if x > 0 else '#F44336' for x in corr_to_overall.values]
bars = ax.barh(corr_to_overall.index, corr_to_overall.values, color=colors_corr, 
               edgecolor='white', alpha=0.8)

    ax.text(val + 0.005 if val > 0 else val - 0.005,
            bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
            f'{val:.3f}', va='center', ha='left' if val > 0 else 'right', fontsize=11)

In [18]:
top3 = corr_to_overall.abs().sort_values(ascending=False).head(3).index.tolist()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(16, 5))

for i, col in enumerate(top3):
    data_clean = df[[col, 'overall_score', 'platform']].dropna()
    
    for j, (platform, group) in enumerate(data_clean.groupby('platform')):
        axes[i].scatter(group[col], group['overall_score'], 
                       alpha=0.4, s=20, label=platform, color=colors_bar[j])
    
    # Trend line
    z = np.polyfit(data_clean[col], data_clean['overall_score'], 1)
    p = np.poly1d(z)
    x_line = np.linspace(data_clean[col].min(), data_clean[col].max(), 100)
    axes[i].plot(x_line, p(x_line), 'k--', linewidth=2, label='Trend')
    
    corr_val = data_clean[col].corr(data_clean['overall_score'])
    axes[i].set_title(f'{col} vs Overall Score\n(r = {corr_val:.3f})', fontweight='bold')
    axes[i].set_xlabel(col)
    axes[i].set_ylabel('Overall Score')
    if i == 0:
        axes[i].legend(fontsize=8)

plt.suptitle('Scatter Plot: Top 3 Kolom vs Overall Score', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('plots/scatter_top3_vs_overall.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5))

data_overall = df['overall_score'].dropna()

# KDE Plot
axes[0].hist(data_overall, bins=30, density=True, alpha=0.6, 
             color='steelblue', edgecolor='white', label='Distribusi')
data_overall.plot.kde(ax=axes[0], color='darkblue', linewidth=2.5, label='KDE')
axes[0].axvline(data_overall.mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', 
                linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {data_overall.mean():.2f}')
axes[0].axvline(data_overall.median(), color='orange', linestyle='--', 
                linewidth=2, label=f'Median: {data_overall.median():.2f}')
axes[0].set_title('Distribusi Overall Score\n(Ceiling Effect Visualization)', fontweight='bold')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Overall Score')
axes[0].legend()

# Pie chart proporsi range nilai
ranges = pd.cut(data_overall, bins=[0, 8.0, 8.5, 9.0, 10.0], 
                labels=['< 8.0', '8.0-8.5', '8.5-9.0', '> 9.0'])
range_counts = ranges.value_counts().sort_index()

axes[1].pie(range_counts.values, labels=range_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
            colors=['#F44336', '#FF9800', '#2196F3', '#4CAF50'],
            startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 12})
axes[1].set_title('Proporsi Range Overall Score\n(Mayoritas di mana?)', fontweight='bold')

plt.suptitle('Analisis Ceiling Effect', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('plots/ceiling_effect_analysis.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

print(f"\nProporsi data per range:")
for label, count in range_counts.items():
    print(f"  {label}: {count} baris ({count/len(data_overall)*100:.1f}%)")

Proporsi data per range:
  < 8.0: 0 baris (0.0%)
  8.0-8.5: 98 baris (2.0%)
  8.5-9.0: 2481 baris (50.3%)
  > 9.0: 2354 baris (47.7%)

print(f"   Total kolom : {df.shape[1]}")
print(f"   Platform    : {df['platform'].nunique()} platform")

# 2. Missing values
print(f"\n2️⃣  MISSING VALUES")
for col in numeric_cols:
    pct = df[col].isnull().sum() / len(df) * 100
    if pct > 0:
        print(f"   {col:20s}: {pct:.1f}% NaN (structural)")

# 3. Ceiling effect
print(f"\n3️⃣  CEILING EFFECT")
skew_overall = df['overall_score'].skew()
print(f"   Skewness overall_score : {skew_overall:.4f}")
print(f"   Mean overall_score     : {df['overall_score'].mean():.2f}")
print(f"   Min overall_score      : {df['overall_score'].min():.1f}")
print(f"   Max overall_score      : {df['overall_score'].max():.1f}")
print(f"   Range efektif          : {df['overall_score'].max() - df['overall_score'].min():.1f} poin")

# 4. Korelasi tertinggi
print(f"\n4️⃣  FITUR PALING BERPENGARUH KE OVERALL SCORE")
corr = df[numeric_cols].corr()['overall_score'].drop('overall_score').abs().sort_values(ascending=False)
for i, (col, val) in enumerate(corr.items(), 1):
    print(f"   {i}. {col:20s}: r = {val:.4f}")

# 5. Imbalance
print(f"\n5️⃣  KETIDAKSEIMBANGAN DATA")
for platform, count in df['platform'].value_counts().items():
    print(f"   {platform:15s}: {count:5,} baris ({count/len(df)*100:.1f}%)")

# 6. Rekomendasi
print(f"\n6️⃣  REKOMENDASI PREPROCESSING")
print(f"   ✅ Handle structural missing → Indicator Variables + Imputasi KNN")
print(f"   ✅ Handle ceiling effect     → Binning (Low/Medium/High) untuk klasifikasi")
print(f"   ✅ Handle imbalance platform → Stratified sampling saat train-test split")
print(f"   ✅ Scaling                   → MinMaxScaler atau StandardScaler")
print(f"   ✅ Drop kolom sparse         → meal, free_wifi, amenities (opsional)")

print("\n" + "="*60)
print("✅ EDA SELESAI! Siap masuk ke tahap Preprocessing.")
print("="*60)
